featured_reviews.name: KartiK Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hidden haven in Bandra that feels like a deep breath

Stumbled upon this gem on the District app while wandering through Bandra. The Yoga House is one of those classic Bandra homes turned into a calm, airy cafe. You won’t spot a flashy sign from the road, so trust Google Maps and keep your eyes peeled for a quiet villa entrance. A staff member guided us upstairs. The first floor looks set up for yoga, and the cafe opens out on the second.

Seating is split into three moods. Indoors for soft light and calm conversations. A leafy outdoor section for sunshine and breezes. And one level up, a shamiana style nook where you sit cross-legged and forget time. It feels like a friend’s mindful terrace more than a commercial cafe.

We picked an outside table. Peaceful. Not crowded. Bandra energy without the traffic noise. Service was warm and unhurried. We tried their Summer Salad. Fruity, crunchy, and bright with mixed produce. Roughly ₹545 all in. Portion was decent and left us satisfied. Prices lean premium, but you are paying for the setting and the slow, healthy focus.

What I loved

1. Tucked away location that keeps it serene

2. Variety of seating that lets you choose your vibe

3. Staff that actually looks after you without hovering

Good to know:
•	Harder to spot from the street, so navigate straight to “The Yoga House” near Nargis Villa or Water Bungalow

•	Menu skews healthy and light. Great if that is your mood, not ideal if you want heavy mains

Verdict:
Come here when you need a gentle pause in the middle of Bandra. Perfect for solo journaling, slow brunch with a book, or a catch-up where you can actually hear each other. If you like trying unique, aesthetic spaces and don’t mind spending a little extra for quiet and quality, this one belongs on your list.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words. We've put in a lot of heart to keep the energy high vibrational and sattvic in our Yoga Studio and Cafe in Bandra. We look forward to seeing you again :)

featured_reviews.name: Kanchana Karthikeyan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been in Sumeet’s online 1 hr classes, 3 times a week, in the morning for 6 months now. Sumeet is extremely meticulous in her approach. She ensures to start the class with 5-7 mins of warm up for asanas that are relevant for the session, and closes the session with gratitude and thought collection for the day.
In the main portion of the yoga session, she not only focuses on ensuring proper posture, she will challenge you to push yourself to perfect the asana. Every session you will discover that your body has become more flexible and is ready for the next challenging asana. She is prompt to introduce variations based on your physical condition/ailments and encourages using props wherever necessary, based on your physiology. She supplements the asanas with the apt amount of theory to help us internalize the positive benefits of the asana. Her strength training knowledge is a bonus. She is extremely careful, patient and encouraging when she introduces new asanas into the mix. She does not hesitate to correct your posture and point out errors to avoid. She actively increases the hold counts, to help realize the benefits of the asana, which I find very valuable during an intensive yoga session.
Needless to say, I can vouch for the fact that, I have improved sleep, a good appetite, and have been yearning for healthy food, these last 6 months. Spinal alignment has improved, deltoids have pushed back to place, and hips have opened up gradually too.
The feeling of rejuvenation after every session is real, and is the exact feeling that that my body has been craving for post-partum.
My million and sincere thanks to Sumeet for all that she is and everything she does. Look no further if you are looking for a yoga teacher, coach, guide and expert, who will make you question your body’s limits in a good way.

featured_reviews.name: Sowjanya Palisetty

✅ Improve blood flow to the reproductive organs

✅ Release deep tension in the lower back and pelvic floor

✅ Lower stress levels (cortisol), which plays a huge role in balancing hormones
